balance.method: Deterministic spatial proxy: nearest common monster from walkable grid points / 3.6 units per second. Straight-line estimate, not actual encounter time or human playtest. Combat fixtures use authoritative simulation and auto-attacks, stationary players, no dodging.

note: Performance samples are diagnostic, not real school hardware or WAN validation. 1 and 12 visible players use one real Electron; 32 clients are simulated. CPU and RAM load samples include server and driver.
